name: entropy_map
description: Shannon entropy across a file in windows. Returns a preview of the profile, the overall figure, the high-entropy runs (the whole list in a file when there are more than 1,000), the bytes processed and whether the pass finished. The complete profile is always written to a file (in a job, under $OUT) under a name that never replaces an earlier file. A window counts as high when its unrounded entropy is >= the threshold. Entropy measures how evenly byte values are spread; it does not identify packing, compression, encryption or intent.

window.description: Window size in bytes, from 64 to 67108864 (default 4096)

threshold.description: Bits per byte at or above which a window counts as high (default 7.2)

max_windows.description: Rows of the profile kept in the answer (default 256); the complete profile is in the file

output_name.description: A plain file name for the profile (default: derived from the source and the window); a name already taken gets a new one and the earlier file is named

max_seconds.description: The tool's own time limit in seconds, from 1 to 280 (default 270); a pass that reaches it stops, the profile holds the windows measured so far, and the answer is partial with bytes_processed
